battle.name: 素羅汗山之戰
battle.brief: 天璽元年（696）秋，吐蕃軍自青海方向越過祁連山北麓，進逼河西走廊中段的素羅汗山一帶，與唐河西邊軍及依附的蕃兵在山口砦柵前反覆爭奪。唐軍依山築壘，以弩手封住隘口、砲車覆蓋山徑，終守住通道，吐蕃退回青海。羅馬 onager 未到此地，但它把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭的思路，正是此役砲車的來源。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 天璽元年（696）秋末，祁連山北麓的這場衝突，交戰雙方是唐朝與吐蕃。唐方的隊伍屬於武則天朝廷直轄的河西邊軍，主體是涼州、甘州、肅州、沙州四州的鎮戍兵與屯田戶所出丁壯，另有瓜州的屯戍與隴右道調來的援軍；各州刺史兼領本州兵，郡兵、縣兵為其骨幹，京師另遣監軍御史隨軍監護糧餉。兵種配置以步卒居中、騎兵兩翼，弩手另編；防守山口的砦柵、壕溝與鹿角由州兵自辦。依附於唐的蕃兵——吐谷渾、黨項以及先後歸附的各部——被編為前驅與游騎，專司探路、斷道與消耗敵方的弩力。吐蕃一方則是贊普尺都珠丹在位、尚書執政的帝國，前線兵權集中在主持東線的尚書一系手上；兵員以青海方向集結的輕騎為骨幹，配披皮甲的步卒，攻城則倚賴從唐軍與西域城邑繳獲的器械。同一時間，契丹李盡忠、孫萬榮起兵攻陷營州，河北震動，唐廷被迫在北方分兵；而西域的粟特商旅又仰賴河西通道，這條走廊的存亡，同時牽動雙方的財政與商利。
countriesEn: The clash that broke out on the northern foot of the Qilian Mountains in the late autumn of the first year of the Tiansi era, 696, was fought between the Tang dynasty and the Tibetan Empire. The Tang force belonged to the frontier army of the Hexi Corridor under the direct command of Empress Wu Zetian's court. Its backbone was the garrison and the militia levies of the four prefectures of Liangzhou, Ganzhou, Suzhou and Shazhou, together with the garrison at Guazhou and reinforcements moved out of Longyou; each prefect held command of the troops of his own prefecture, the prefectural and county levies forming the core, and the capital sent military supervisors to watch the grain. Infantry formed the centre, cavalry the wings, and the crossbowmen were kept as a separate body; the stockades, ditches and thorn fences that guarded the passes were raised by the prefectural soldiers themselves. The auxiliaries who had submitted to the Tang, the Yü-ko-hun, the T'ang-hsiang and the clans that came over one by one, were enrolled as scouts and outriders, their task to find the road, cut the line of march and wear down the enemy's crossbow fire. On the Tibetan side was an empire whose tsanpo was Thê-tu Tsuktsen while the great ministers held the government; field authority in these parts was concentrated in the line of great ministers who directed the eastern theatre. Their army was built on light cavalry mustered in the Kokonor region, with armoured infantry to support them and, for siege work, machines captured from Tang troops and from the cities of the western regions. At the same moment the Khitan under Li Chin-chung and Sun Wan-jung rose, took Ying-chou and shook Hopei, so the court had to divide its forces to the north; and the Sogdian merchants of the western regions depended on the Hexi artery, so the fate of this corridor touched the finances and the trade of both sides at once.
people: 此役的關鍵人物，漢文史料留下的名字極少，可以確定的是三層。第一層是武則天本人：天璽元年她南巡封禪泰山，於山上一面改元「萬歲登封」、一面加尊號，隨後又以聖神皇帝之名大赦天下，把重心放在聲望與內部權鬥上；正因為如此，河西用兵只能取守勢，既不增援也不求一決勝負，邊將自行處置的權力被放大，這既保住了走廊，也意味著沒有人能從更高處統一調度。北方契丹之亂、皇嗣與武氏諸王的相爭，都把注意力釘在關內。第二層是唐方前線的州刺史與軍將：這批人的姓名在兩《唐書》與《資治通鑑》中多已失傳，只留下「河西」「隴右」這些建制痕跡；史家往往把此類戰役的勝負歸給天時與地利，把軍功記在隨軍宦官與監軍身上，這種記法本身就說明唐方此役缺少一位有明確名姓的總帥。第三層在吐蕃：贊普尺都珠丹居於後方，主持東線的尚書一系才是真正在前線調度兵馬的人，漢文史料中留下姓名的重臣是尚書論三仁，他長期主持吐蕃的東線軍務；其後接掌軍政的族人在唐長安至神龍年間仍不斷與唐軍在湟水一線交鋒。戰役本身的統帥姓名，傳世記載無可補，這是本役史實最薄的一環，任何確切的斬獲與損耗數字都不宜虛構。
peopleEn: The names that survive for this campaign in the Chinese records are very few, and what can be fixed amounts to three layers. The first is Empress Wu Zetian herself. In the first year of Tiansi she toured the south and performed the Fengshan sacrifice on Mount Tai, changing the era name there to Wansui Dengfeng and adding a new honorific, and then, under the title of the Holy and Divine Emperor, issued a general amnesty; she placed her weight on prestige and on the struggle for succession inside the palace. Precisely for that reason the war in the northwest could only be fought on the defensive: no reinforcements were sent and no decisive result was sought, and the authority of the frontier commanders to act on their own was enlarged, which saved the corridor but also meant that nobody higher up could direct the campaign as a whole. The Khitan rising in the north and the quarrel between the Crown Prince and the princes of the Wu house both pinned the court's attention inside the passes. The second layer is the Tang commanders in the field, the prefects and army officers of the Hexi: most of their names are lost in the two Histories of the Tang and in the Comprehensive Mirror, and only the trace of the administrative structure, 'Hexi' and 'Longyou', remains. Historians tend to ascribe the outcome of fighting of this kind to heaven and earth, and to book the merit for the eunuchs and supervisors who followed the army, and that way of recording itself says that this campaign had no grand commander with a name to remember. The third layer is on the Tibetan side. The tsanpo Thê-tu Tsuktsen sat in the rear, while the line of great ministers who directed the eastern theatre were the men who actually shifted the armies in front. The heavy minister whose name Chinese sources preserve is Lun San-jen, who for long handled the eastern military affairs of the empire; after him his kin went on meeting Tang armies in the fighting along the Yellow River sources from the Chang'an era to the Shenlung era. The names of the commanders of this battle itself cannot be recovered, and that is the thinnest part of the record; no exact figures for captures or losses should be invented to fill the gap.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是 onager，羅馬人的投石機：扭力束把牛筋、馬筋與人髮絞成一股，藏進木製底架的橫樑與立柱之間，一根單投臂斜架其上，臂端有皮兜兜住石彈，發射時全靠扭力把臂拉過直角再脫手，沒有配重、沒有吊索，換句話說，羅馬人把絞盤裡儲存的勢能直接換成一塊石頭。優點是重量輕、可整體拖行，在野地裡就地架設也能重複使用；缺點是每次上弦都要人重新扭動絞盤，射速低得可憐，射程大致在一百五十至二百五十米的量級。它在素羅汗山這場攻防裡所對應的角色，是唐軍與吐蕃手中同原理的中國砲車（拋石車）：《後漢書》記公孫瓚與袁紹界橋之戰用「洞霄車」飛石，隋朝攻高麗亦用拋石車，說明這套扭力拋擲技術在東亞出現得比很多人以為的更早。唐邊軍的常備配置是蹶張弩與擘張弩，一發一中的蹶張弩用於近距封隘，擘張弩可平放連發，另有角弓、橫刀、槊、明光鎧、兜鍪與披膊，馬兵配馬鎧與馬槊；吐蕃兵以漆皮弓、長刀、標槍為主，甲胄多為皮甲與來自粟特、波斯工匠的鎖子甲，坐騎以馬與犛牛為主。運輸是此役最現實的難題：山徑只能靠騾、馬馱運，石彈需在山腳現採現製，砲車本身要拆件分載，這一點與羅馬人在自家圍城線上就地取材的作法相同。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the onager, the Roman stone-thrower. A torsion bundle of twisted ox sinew, horse sinew and human hair was set into the crossbeams and uprights of a timber frame; a single throwing arm was raked up on it, with a sling at the tip to hold the stone, and the shot was released by the torsion alone, hauling the arm past the horizontal and letting go. There was no counterweight and no suspension rope. In other words, the Romans converted the energy stored in a winch directly into a stone. The advantages were that it was light, could be dragged whole and could be set up again and again on open ground; the drawback was that every shot demanded that men twist the skein afresh, so the rate of fire was pitifully slow and the range was on the order of a hundred and fifty to two hundred and fifty metres. The counterpart of this machine in the fighting at Mount Suoluohan was the Chinese stone-thrower of the same principle, the pao-ch'e or throw-stone carriage: the History of the Later Han records the 'Tung-hsiao carriage' hurling stones in the battle of the Chieh bridge between Kung-sun Tsan and Yuan Shao, and the Sui threw stones with the same kind of machine in its campaigns against Koguryo, which shows that this torsion technique appeared in East Asia earlier than many people suppose. The standing kit of the Tang frontier soldier was the two-man drawn crossbow and the bedded crossbow, the former used to close a pass at close range with one bolt at a time, the latter able to fire a series of bolts while laid flat, together with composite bows, sabres, lances, bright armour, helmets and shoulder guards, and the cavalry had barding and horse lances. The Tibetan soldier fought with lacquered bows, long knives, javelins, armour of hide and mail worked by Sogdian and Persian craftsmen, and rode horses and yaks. Transport was the most stubborn difficulty of this campaign: the mountain tracks could carry loads only on mules and horses, the stone shot had to be quarried and dressed at the foot of the hill, and the thrower itself had to be broken down and carried in parts, a point on which the Romans, besieging their own enemies on their own lines, had done much the same.
tactics: 山地的攻防決定了這一戰的打法。唐軍的部署是典型的守隘：先在素羅汗山一線的高處築土壘、插木柵、掘壕溝、置鹿角，砦中留出砲車的射位，讓石彈越過前陣落在谷道上；弩手分為兩班，專射任何試圖接近壕溝的密集隊形，步卒據塹而守，騎兵藏在兩翼坡後，等對方的攻勢被壕溝與弩火消耗之後再出擊，切斷退路或襲擊其後方的糧隊。吐蕃的戰法是先以游騎清道，再以披甲步卒扛盾、扛梯逼近，試圖在弩火下把石頭壘的牆面打開缺口；一旦守軍弩力耗竭或砲車被逼近，其輕騎便會湧入缺口與兩側。時間上，秋季是唯一可行的出兵季節：祁連山口的積雪未化，牧草尚未枯，戰馬尚有草料；而到冬季，山道被雪封死，糧車無法上行，兩軍都只能退守州城。整條糧道自涼州沿走廊東行，經甘州、肅州而至前線，途中沒有可以屯糧的大城，全靠州縣屯田與就地收購的穀物支撐，最後一段山路由蕃兵護送，腳力與騾馬成為比弓弩更決定成敗的東西。砲車的用法在攻守兩面都要提：守方靠它覆蓋通道，攻方則可用繳獲的唐軍砲車反轟城頭與密集的攻隊，砲與砲之間的較量，往往比白刃相接更早決定城頭的歸屬。
tacticsEn: Fighting in the mountains decided the manner of this battle. The Tang deployment was the classic defence of a pass: earthworks were raised on the heights along the line of Mount Suoluohan, wooden palisades set up, ditches dug and thorn fences planted, and firing positions were left in the stockade for the stone-throwers so that the shot would pass over the front line and land on the valley track. The crossbowmen worked in two reliefs and concentrated on any body of men that tried to come up to the ditch; the infantry held the trench; the cavalry lay back on the slopes of both wings and waited for the assault to be spent against the ditch and the crossbow fire before falling on the enemy to cut the retreat or strike the baggage behind them. The Tibetan method was to clear the way with outriders first, and then to bring up armoured infantry with shields and scaling ladders, trying to open a breach in the stone facing under the crossbow fire; once the defenders' strength with the crossbows was spent, or the throwers came under pressure, their light horse would pour through the breach and around the flanks. As to season, autumn was the only feasible time to take the field: the snow at the Qilian passes had not yet closed and the grazing had not yet failed, so the horses still had fodder; by winter the tracks were under snow, the grain carts could no longer climb, and both armies had to fall back on the prefectural cities. The whole grain line ran east from Liangzhou along the corridor, through Ganzhou and Suzhou to the front, with no great city on the way in which to quarter it, and it was supported entirely by the farms of the prefectures and counties and by grain bought on the spot; the last stretch of mountain road was guarded by the auxiliaries, and there it was legs and mules, not bows and crossbows, that decided more of the outcome. The use of the stone-thrower has to be mentioned on both sides: the defenders covered the pass with it, and the attackers could turn captured Tang machines back on the city walls and on the crowded assault columns, and the exchange of stone against stone often decided the ownership of a wall before the blades met.
data: 能核對的數字只到量級，多數是推算而非記載。時間：天璽元年（696）秋季集兵，秋季至冬季前段交兵，整場戰事延續數十日，冬季到來前雙方各自收兵。距離：河西走廊自涼州至瓜州約一千一百公里，涼州至甘州約二百公里，甘州至肅州約二百公里，肅州至瓜州約三百五十公里，瓜州至玉門關約九十公里；素羅汗山在祁連山北麓，距甘州、肅州各數百里不等，具體山峰位置至今無定論，所標的經緯度只能視為祁連北麓中段一帶的概略位置。兵力：唐方四州加瓜州的州兵與縣兵，量級在數千至萬餘之間，蕃兵與屯田民兵另計；吐蕃方面史無確數，但以當年青海可集結的輕騎推想，投入此線的兵力當以數萬計。旁證是六百七十年的《大非川之戰》，《資治通鑑》記薛仁貴「率十萬眾討吐蕃」而全軍覆沒，那是唐廷傾國出征的上限；素羅汗山一役的規模顯然遠小於此，卻正因如此才沒有留下大敗的記錄。裝備：扭力砲車的射程大致在一百五十至二百五十米，石彈重量在數十斤到百餘斤之間，折合今日約三十至六十公斤上下，一發石彈要重新上弦並重新瞄準，射速極低；弩的射程一般不超過二百步。以上距離與數字多屬量級推估，傷亡數字則完全不見於傳世記載，講述此役只能說勝負未分，不應編造任何精確的頭數。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked reach only the level of magnitude, and most of them are estimates rather than records. Timing: the armies were assembled in the autumn of 696, the fighting ran through the autumn into the first part of the winter, the whole business lasted some tens of days, and each side drew off its troops before the winter closed in. Distance: the Hexi Corridor runs for about eleven hundred kilometres from Liangzhou to Guazhou, some two hundred kilometres from Liangzhou to Ganzhou, about two hundred more from Ganzhou to Suzhou, roughly three hundred and fifty from Suzhou to Guazhou, and about ninety from Guazhou to the Yumen Pass. Mount Suoluohan lies on the northern foot of the Qilian range, some hundreds of li from both Ganzhou and Suzhou, and the exact peak has never been identified, so the coordinates given here can only be read as a rough position for the middle stretch of the northern foot of the range. Strength: the prefectural and county levies of the four prefectures together with Guazhou, on the order of several thousand to more than ten thousand, with the auxiliaries and the militia of the farms counted apart; on the Tibetan side there is no reliable number, but judging by the light horse that could be mustered in the Kokonor region, the force committed to this line must have run to tens of thousands. A useful comparison is the battle of Ta-fei-ch'uan in 670, where the Comprehensive Mirror records Hsüeh Jen-kuei as leading one hundred thousand men against the Tibetans and being wiped out, which was the limit of what the Tang court could commit; the scale of the fighting at Mount Suoluohan was plainly far smaller, and precisely for that reason no great defeat was recorded. Equipment: the range of a torsion thrower was on the order of a hundred and fifty to two hundred and fifty metres, the stone weighed from several tens of catties to more than a hundred, roughly thirty to sixty kilograms in modern measure, every shot had to be re-strung and re-aimed, and the rate of fire was very low; the range of a crossbow generally did not exceed two hundred paces. These distances and figures are largely estimates of magnitude, and the casualty figures do not appear in the transmitted record at all, so the only honest statement about the outcome of this campaign is that it was undecided, and no exact head-count should be invented.
cause: 要理解為何會在素羅汗山開打，須把三層原因疊起來看。最裡層是舊賬：六百七十年的《大非川之戰》與六百七十八年的青海之戰，唐軍連續大敗，吐蕃的騎兵由此占據青海，並把唐朝的西界推到祁連山腳下；再往東推進數百里，就會切斷絲路的中段。中層是雙方各自的結構性需求：吐蕃在贊普統治下完成整合，把青海、吐谷渾與西域的交通線握在手中，往河西推進可以同時解決戰場縱深與商路收益；唐朝則不能丟掉涼、甘、肅、沙四州，因為這四州的屯田是關中與洛陽之外最可靠的一批軍糧來源，丟掉走廊等於丟掉整個西北的財政。表層是具體的導火線：天璽元年前後，吐蕃游騎越過舊界，在祁連山北麓的村落與牧場擄取牲畜、糧秣，唐邊軍按例出戰，衝突就在這樣的遭遇裡定型，山口成了必須爭奪的焦點。還有一層容易被忽略的背景：同期契丹李盡忠、孫萬榮起兵攻陷營州，河北震動，唐廷把注意力與兵力都抽向北邊，河西只能靠現有邊軍自保，這正是此役規模有限、雙方都沒有傾力投入的原因。
causeEn: To understand why the fighting broke out at Mount Suoluohan, three layers of cause have to be put one on top of the other. The innermost is an old debt: after the defeat at Ta-fei-ch'uan in 670 and the battle at Kokonor in 678, in which the Tang armies were beaten twice in succession, the Tibetan horse had the upper hand in the Kokonor region and had pushed the western frontier of the Tang down to the foot of the Qilian Mountains; a further advance of several hundred li eastwards would have cut the middle of the Silk Road. The middle layer is the structural need of each side: under the tsanpo the Tibetan state had completed its unification, holding the Kokonor, the Tuyuhun and the routes of the western regions in one hand, and pushing into Hexi would solve at once the problem of the depth of its battlefields and the profit of the trade road. The Tang, for its part, could not afford to lose the four prefectures of Liang, Gan, Su and Sha, because the farms of those four were the most reliable source of military grain outside the passes of Kuanchung and Luoyang; losing the corridor would have meant losing the whole fiscal basis of the northwest. The outermost layer is the immediate occasion: around the first year of Tiansi Tibetan outriders crossed the old frontier and carried off cattle and grain from the villages and pastures on the northern foot of the Qilian, and the Tang frontier troops marched out as was their duty, so that the clash hardened in an encounter of this kind and the pass became the point that had to be fought for. One more background is easily overlooked: at the same time Li Chin-chung and Sun Wan-jung rose among the Khitan, took Ying-chou and shook Hopei, so the Tang court drew its attention and its troops northwards, and Hexi was left to hold itself with the troops already on hand. That is why this campaign stayed small in scale and why neither side committed everything.
impact: 這一役沒有改變任何一方的戰略格局，卻決定了西北邊防在此後十年所走的路徑。對唐朝而言，素羅汗山守住的好處是實在的：河西四州與瓜州無恙，涼州到玉門關的通道繼續通行，粟特與中亞商旅的馬隊不必繞道，關中每年可以從河西調運屯田的淨糧；更細的影響在編制上，砲車被明確地當作邊防常備火力而不是臨時器械，於是配套的石工、木工、採石與獸筋供應被固定下來，守城的技術門檻提高了，後來唐蕃在瓜州、湟源的拉鋸都建立在這批常備能力上；蕃兵被編為前驅的做法也固定下來，羈縻與軍事利用在河西同時進行。對吐蕃而言，這是一次沒有收穫的試探：河西沒有突破，東線的兵鋒停在山腳，但他們也沒有損失慘重，得以保存騎兵主力，八世紀前期吐蕃在青海與湟源方向再度發起攻勢時，兵力和經驗都還在手上。政治上，武則天在封禪與大赦的同時得到一份邊報，朝廷在北方契丹之亂中沒有垮台，也讓「北邊可控」的說法在國內站得住腳。將來看，這一役的真正意義在於它是一個標本：在沒有足夠援兵、只能靠地形與器械說話的邊境上，誰把石頭與弩的效率用得更高，誰就能守住沒有城牆可倚的山口。
impactEn: This campaign changed no strategic pattern for either side, and yet it set the course of the northwestern frontier for the ten years that followed. For the Tang the value of holding Mount Suoluohan was plain: the four prefectures and Guazhou were untouched, the road from Liangzhou to the Yumen Pass stayed open, the caravans of Sogdian and Central Asian merchants did not have to go round, and every year Kuanchung could draw a net surplus of grain from the farms of Hexi. The finer effect lay in organisation: the stone-thrower was now clearly treated as a standing frontier weapon rather than an improvised one, so the masons, carpenters, quarrying and the supply of sinew that went with it were all put on a regular footing, the technical threshold of defence was raised, and the later see-saw between Tang and Tibet at Guazhou and the Yellow River sources was fought on the strength of these standing capacities. The practice of enrolling the auxiliaries as advance troops was regularised as well, so that pacification and military use went on side by side in Hexi. For the Tibetans it was a probe that brought no gain: the corridor was not broken and the eastern spearhead stopped at the foot of the mountains, but neither were they badly hurt, and the main body of their horse was preserved, so that when they struck again toward the Kokonor and the Yellow River sources in the early eighth century the men and the experience were still there. Politically, Empress Wu had a report from the frontier to set beside her sacrifice at Tai and her general amnesty; the court did not collapse under the Khitan rising in the north, and the claim that the north was under control still stood at home. Seen at a distance, the real significance of this campaign is that it is a specimen: on a frontier with no reinforcements to speak of, where only terrain and machinery could speak, whoever used stone and crossbow more efficiently held the pass where there was no wall to lean on.
result: 素羅汗山之戰以雙方各自收兵告終。唐軍保住了山口的砦與通往走廊的通道，吐蕃沒有被消滅，只是退回青海方向，兩軍都沒有在那一帶留下能決定勝負的殘酷戰果；史籍對此役的記載因此停在「勝負未分」的概括上，具體的斬獲、俘虜與損耗都無從核對。放到更大的時間軸上看，這是一場決定性的僵局：它讓唐朝的西北防線維持到八世紀初，吐蕃的東線攻勢在整個七世紀末都沒有越過祁連北麓，直到神龍政變之後唐廷重新掌握主動權，形勢才開始逆轉。回到卡面這件兵器：onager 本身並不曾出現在祁連山北麓，羅馬帝國解體之後它就隨著西羅馬的陷落而從歐洲的戰場上退場，只留下「把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭」這個設計思路。它一路傳到中亞，再以拋石車的形式出現在唐軍的砲位與吐蕃繳獲的器械上，最終在十二、十三世紀與配重式投石機匯合。而素羅汗山這場僵局真正示範的，正是這件兵器的本質：山口的勝負不取決於誰的弓弩更利，而取決於誰能把石頭準確地送進對方的隊形裡，以及誰的山路更短、糧道更省力。
resultEn: The battle of Mount Suoluohan ended with both sides drawing off. The Tang kept the stockade on the pass and the road into the corridor; the Tibetans were not destroyed but fell back toward the Kokonor; neither army inflicted on the other the kind of ruinous blow that settles a war. The records of this campaign therefore stop at a summary statement that the result was undecided, and the captures, the prisoners and the losses cannot be checked. On a longer axis this was a decisive stalemate: it held the northwestern line of the Tang together into the early eighth century, and the eastern offensive of Tibet did not cross the northern foot of the Qilian for the rest of the seventh century, until after the Shenlung coup, when the Tang court regained the initiative and the situation began to reverse. Back to the weapon on the card. The onager itself never appeared on the northern foot of the Qilian; once the Roman state came apart it withdrew from the battlefields of Europe together with the fall of the western empire, leaving behind only the idea of converting the energy stored in a winch into a stone. That idea travelled east through Central Asia and reappeared in China as the stone-throwing carriage, in the firing positions of the Tang army and in the machines the Tibetans had captured, until in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries it met the counterweight trebuchet. And what the stalemate at Mount Suoluohan really demonstrates is the nature of this weapon: the issue at a pass was never which side had the sharper bow, but who could put a stone accurately into the enemy's formations, and whose mountain road was shorter and whose supply line cost less.
